name: fmp_13f_filing
description:
Form 13F holdings report of one institutional investment manager (for example a hedge fund) from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP): securities held, shares and value.
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/13f as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): cik* (SEC CIK of the filer, as a string).
To find a CIK use fmp_cik_list; for the holders of one stock use fmp_institutional_holders.
Example: {"cik": "0001067983"}
